coverage: Every unique configuration in the complete Dev-frozen neck72 Test selection, preserving all role aliases and negative accuracy cases; no Test score used to choose costs.

sampling.sequences: Both complete-protocol Dev sequences for source engineering, then all7Test sequences for measured cost.

input_contract: Actual current RGB and fixed November DiffV2IR only when consumed. Recompute original detector, NMS, consumed appearance/shape/color/quality, FP32 post-neck reference and enabled native vector/alignment, RGB body-point/LK/votes, and original query/ByteTrack decisions. Banks are reference comparisons outside timers, never substituted as inference inputs.

numerics.detector: Original unfused FP16 model/postprocess, B1; source accuracy originally used B4.
numerics.appearance: Original FP16 pre-neck model; produce only raw/RGB-mask consumed views, batch<=64.
numerics.identity: Original FP32 post-neck weights/BN, TF32 disabled, batch<=64, fixed Train alignment.

engineering: All frozen cases must pass source/track equivalence on both32-frame Dev prefixes before any Test runtime. Preserve every diagnostic mismatch without changing any scientific model or selecting on Test. Failure remains pending runtime debugging, not a valid cost-for-accuracy claim.
timers: Synchronized B1 frame latency includes file IO/decode, preprocessing/transfers, all consumed CNN and classical operations, dynamic packets and tracker. Record per-component durations and their actual total; never sum component FPS. Weight/verification-bank loading, provenance hashing, comparison/track serialization and offline IR generation excluded and disclosed.
release: Only after complete neck72 accuracy export and actual controller/child process exit. Current healthy preceding GPU work is untouched.
scope: Stratified seven-video prefix full-component cost, not full15985frame FPS, an unbounded deployment implementation, a seed variance study, new accuracy, another fusion architecture or an innovation.
